rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person or project showing strong ambition.

example.english: They’re so ambitious; they’ll reach the top sooner or later.
example.traditional: 佢咁有野心，遲早會升到最高位。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 jau5 je5 sam1 ci4 zou2 wui5 sing1 dou3 zeoi3 gou1 wai2

rows.note: Use this for a person whose ambition is viewed positively as enterprising and self-improving.

example.english: They’re ambitious and even study after work.
example.traditional: 佢好進取，放工後仲去讀書。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 zeon3 ceoi2 fong3 gung1 hau6 zung6 heoi3 duk6 syu1

rows.note: Use this mainly for a plan, goal, or vision that is lofty and far-reaching.

example.english: This vision is ambitious and worth supporting.
example.traditional: 呢個願景遠大，值得支持。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jyun6 ging2 jyun5 daai6 zik6 dak1 zi1 ci4

rows.note: Use this colloquially when someone is itching or very eager to do or have something.

example.english: I’m feeling ambitious about getting a new phone—I want to buy one right away.
example.traditional: 我心思思，想即刻買部新電話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 si1 si1 soeng2 zik1 hak1 maai5 bou6 san1 din6 waa6
